messages:
ashley: Heads-up: did a targeted sample validation run for audit logs across services. Posting summary + ask.

ashley: Scope: API GW, auth, console, billing, runtime — ~5k events sampled from the last 7 days. Tools used: auditcat + local json-schema validator.

mike: Nice, quick hits?

ashley: Top gaps I found: 
- runtime: startup/shutdown events often missing structured host_id/container_id.
- billing: refund events sometimes missing customer_id and amount_cents.
- auth: grant/revoke flows missing context.request_id in a subset of traces.
- console: feature-toggles UI actions not emitting user.agent (makes client attribution hard).
- api-gw: client IP masked in ~2% of events because of proxy header ordering.

jordana: Can you paste an example of the runtime event we expect vs what we see?

ashley: Expected vs observed (example):
```
# expected (runtime.startup)
{
  "event_type": "runtime.startup",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-12T09:12:33Z",
  "host_id": "i-0b12c34d",
  "container_id": "c-9a8b7c6d",
  "image": "redwood/runtime:1.4.2",
  "request_id": "req-12345"
}

# observed
{
  "event_type": "runtime.startup",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-12T09:12:33Z",
  "image": "redwood/runtime:1.4.2",
  "request_id": "req-12345"
}
```

marco: KMS integration note: billing.refund events should surface envelope.key_id or kms_key_id for customer evidence. Who owns that change on the billing side?

eva: That sits with billing — I'll loop in @sarah-billing. In the short term we can add a validator rule to flag missing amount_cents and key_id so it shows in nightly reports.

security-bot: Automated check: added rule `billing.required_fields` to the validator bundle. It will start alerting on the next ingest window.

mike: On the RBAC/schema side: adding fields is fine. Renaming/removing fields is breaking. Propose we follow additive-only schema changes and ship enforcement behind a feature flag for one sprint.

ashley: +1. Proposal: schema v1.2 = additive fields only. Ramp enforcement after 4 weeks of non-enforced monitoring. Create migration doc + sample payloads.

jordana: Backlog plan: I'll open four tickets: runtime-host-fields (3d), billing-refund-schema (4d, includes KMS work), auth-requestid-coverage (2d), console-agent-string (1d).

marco: Also need post-deploy validation: nightly job that samples ~1k events per service and runs the validator, output to S3 + alert to #eng-security on anomalies. I can take that.

ashley: Action items: 1) jordana create tickets + owners; 2) marco setup nightly sample job; 3) eva contact billing/KMS and loop in infra-kms; 4) mike finalize schema proposal by EOD Thu. I'll assign owners in the tickets. :thumbsup:

eva: :thumbsup: assigning to sarah-billing and cc'ing @infra-kms.

mike: Any objections to enforcement behind a feature flag for 2 weeks while we monitor for false positives?

ashley: No objections. Use feature flag `audit.schema.v1.2.enforce` default `off`, ramp to `on` when monitoring looks clean.

jordana: I'll include the sample validator output in the ticket thread. Example failing line I pulled:
```
2026-03-12T09:12:34Z ERROR audit: event=\"billing.refund\" user_id=\"u-999\" payload=\"{\\\"event_type\\\":\\\"billing.refund\\\",\\\"timestamp\\\":\\\"2026-03-12T09:12:34Z\\\",\\\"user_id\\\":\\\"u-999\\\",\\\"note\\\":\\\"refund processed\\\"}\"`
```

ashley: Thanks — we should sync tomorrow 10:30 to review tickets and owners. Tagging folks: @mike @jordana @marco @eva

security-bot: Reminder: if audit validation failures exceed 0.5% of events or critical fields are missing for >100 events/hr, open an incident in #incidents and notify oncall.

ashley: Closing the loop here — will update thread once tickets exist.
